XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Reliability level key

* low level : Reported by a garage mechanic; fault case not recorded by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Widespread occurrence of the fault, confirmed by service technicians and independent repairers.

*** high level : Confirmed fault, with a high degree of ‘recurrence’ reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Injection

  • Device: Engine speed sensor

  • Fault: The vehicle exhibits significantly reduced performance even at low revs, jerky operation and an irregular engine speed whilst stationary.

  • Errors detected by the self-diagnostic system: - -

  • Cause: Faulty engine speed sensor

• Action: Check that the engine speed sensor is working correctly and, if necessary, replace it

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: The faulty component is located between the engine and the radiator, on the lower part of the engine, on the passenger side, on the crankshaft pulley.
